data.name: Clone Trooper
data.description: A standard clone trooper unit, trained for combat and loyalty to the Republic.

data.name: Clone Commander
data.description: An elite clone officer commanding squads with Phase II armor and tactical authority.

data.name: Worker
data.description: A civilian support unit capable of operating machinery and logistics equipment.

data.name: B1 Battle Droid
data.description: A basic battle droid unit, mass-produced for the Separatist forces.

data.name: B2 Super Battle Droid
data.description: A heavily armoured Separatist droid with dual wrist blasters and enhanced plating.

data.name: Droideka
data.description: A Separatist destroyer droid that rolls into combat and deploys a deflector shield.

data.name: Buzz Droid
data.description: A small sabotage droid launched as a projectile to disable enemy ships and vehicles.

data.name: DC-15A Blaster Rifle
data.description: Standard clone trooper blaster rifle with long range and reliable performance.

data.name: E-5 Blaster Rifle
data.description: Standard-issue Separatist blaster carried by B1 battle droids — light and inexpensive.

data.name: Z-6 Rotary Blaster
data.description: A heavy rotary blaster cannon favoured by clone heavy troopers for suppressing fire.

data.name: Vibroblade
data.description: A high-frequency vibrating blade capable of cutting through most armour plating.

data.name: Durasteel Ingot
data.description: Refined durasteel alloy smelted from Mustafar's volcanic ore fields.

data.name: Sith Poison
data.description: A deadly alchemical compound synthesised from Quesh venom in Sith labs.

data.name: Refined Kyber Crystal
data.description: A precisely cut Kyber crystal from Ilum, highly sought after by Force users.
